design_disclosure: Designed after the negative D3 field endpoint and after the D2 detector-only tunnel CV; cannot replace either frozen primary analysis.

selection.positive_enriched_overlap: select row modulo 4 equals 0 and column modulo 4 equals 0, converting the fixed 128-pixel lattice to a non-overlapping 512-pixel lattice without using image, mask, model, or outcome content
selection.full_grid: use every already eligible non-overlapping tile

degradation.implementation: scipy.ndimage.gaussian_filter(mode=reflect) followed by deterministic zero-mean Gaussian noise in 8-bit DN and clipping/rounding to uint8
degradation.reference: the unmodified D2 grayscale tile before added synthetic degradation

image_contract.color_handling: OpenCV RGB-to-gray; replicate the same grayscale image to three normalized detector channels for reference, degraded, task-OFF, and task-ON
image_contract.reason: avoid a color-versus-grayscale arm confound because the fixed MERIT restorer outputs one grayscale channel
image_contract.restorer_input: grayscale in channel 0 plus two zero-valued prompt maps
image_contract.restorer_output: clip to [0,1], round to uint8 before detector evaluation

detectors.architecture: fold-specific ResNet34-UNet trained on the other three D2 tunnels

statistics.aggregation: compute each parent continuous-lining segment first; average the three paired detector-restorer chains within parent; average parents within tunnel; report four-tunnel equal-weight macro
statistics.bootstrap: 10000 stratified parent-cluster resamples within tunnel, then equal-weight the four tunnel macros
statistics.no_pseudoreplication: tile count describes image coverage only; inferential resampling unit is the parent continuous-lining segment

gates.degradation_manipulation: reference minus degraded AUPRC is positive in at least three of four tunnel macros
gates.task_on_primary: task_on minus degraded equal-tunnel AUPRC delta is positive, its stratified parent-bootstrap 95% lower bound is above zero, and at least three of four tunnel deltas are positive
gates.task_loss_increment: task_on minus task_off is claimed only if the same AUPRC point, lower-bound, and three-of-four-tunnels rule passes
gates.fixed_threshold_secondary: F1 at 0.5 is secondary and never overrides a failed primary AUPRC gate

claim_boundary.allowed_if_primary_passes: MERIT improves detector AUPRC on expert-annotated imagery from four previously unseen tunnels after the manuscript's fixed synthetic joint blur-noise degradation, using tunnel-held-out detectors.
claim_boundary.forbidden: Natural-degradation recovery on the different D2 camera, actual cross-device optical calibration, physical crack-width recovery, field safety, zero hallucination, full-grid specificity for all four tunnels, or confirmatory replacement of the earlier frozen endpoints.
claim_boundary.positive_enrichment: Only parents 0055 and 0211 are full-grid. Other parents remain positive-enriched covered regions even after non-overlap subsampling.
